usedFor: Raisely holds fundraising people, profiles and donations, and “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly makes a link when one changes.

bestTemplate.name: “Donation Succeeded” in Raisely, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A completed gift is a good moment to offer a call, and the action returns the link to book it.

watchOut: “New Campaign” in Raisely polls on a schedule, while “New Person” is pushed, so only the first has a delay.
